annotations: North Bethesda bike lanes, the owner's report from the street: "The first image has a protected bike lane that isn't listed and the second has a listed bike lane that doesn't exist". Woodglen Drive (Edson Lane to Nicholson Lane) has a two-way protected bike lane on its west side that OSM tags as a painted lane; Executive Boulevard (Nicholson Lane to Marinelli Road) and Grand Park Avenue (Marinelli Road to Old Georgetown Road) have none, though OSM tags a protected track. The county's 2026 project (MR2026029) plans one there; when it is built, retire these corridor rows. The OSM tags are corrected upstream separately (the owner's edit, scripts/osm_edit.py); these rows set the level and the Why line now, whatever the extract holds.

value.public_note: A two-way protected bike lane behind posts on the west side of a 2-lane street; driveways and two-way crossings keep it off 1: our level, 1.5. Montgomery County says 3; MDOT SHA says 1.

rows.reason: The owner, on Woodglen Drive between Edson Lane and Nicholson Lane: "a protected bike lane that isn't listed". OSM tags only a painted lane on the west side (cycleway:left=lane), and the earlier rows rated the street as having no bike lane (2.5 and 2). Our judgment, not measured: 1.5, half a step above 1 for the driveway and street crossings the county marked in green and a two-way track's contraflow at them.
rows.evidence: The owner's report from the street. Montgomery County DOT's own description of it, as built in 2014: a two-way, 8 ft track on the west side from Edson Lane to Nicholson Lane, behind a 3 ft buffer with flex posts (WTOP, 2014-10, https://wtop.com/news/2014/10/montgomery-co-installing-cycle-track-in-north-bethesda). OSM, read 2026-11-10: way 5971047, highway=tertiary, lanes=2, cycleway:left=lane.

rows.reason: The owner, on Executive Boulevard north of Nicholson Lane: "a listed bike lane that doesn't exist". OSM tags a protected track (cycleway=track, added 2023 to 2026, ahead of the county's project), and the earlier row rated it for that track. With no bike lane our formula reads a 30 mph urban street at 3 whatever its lane count (stress.URBAN_SCORED_LANES).
rows.evidence: The owner's report from the street.
